known_limits: Monthly-host observed producer has no durable idempotency receipt; equal browser request keys do not prove single persisted effect or reconciliation.
Transport/browser fixtures can qualify client behaviors only, not native load/execution, model access, business identity or full C15/C17.
New root interfaces and shell/C10 changes require their own final diff review and hosted evidence.

resolved_findings: Unknown writes keep payload/key frozen; later CAS rejection remains inconclusive instead of falsely not-applied.
Late analysis list/output responses cannot repopulate restricted history after revocation.
Refresh requests coalesce while an earlier empty list is in flight.
Transient history failures preserve open result and reason; explicit denial removes restricted content.
Conversation reopen asks before discarding reply; preflight answer-confirmation failure restores controls.
cold_review.test_review: 13 browser tests inspect shipped UI scripts with explicit transport fixtures. These discriminate client branches, not native execution or durable domain receipt behavior.
cold_review.remaining_boundary: Real monthly producer lacks durable idempotency receipt/reconciliation. A request key observed twice is not proof of one persisted effect.
